verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own help center has dedicated first-party articles for both parts of the story: 'Scheduled Send' (send later) and 'Undo send' (retract within a grace window). The pack only contains the article titles, not their contents, so details of either feature cannot be verified. Missing for 10: details of scheduling options and of the undo grace-window length or configurability, independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
